quotations.projectAddress: 32 Ascott Gardens, West Bridgford, Nottingham, NG2 7TH
quotations.projectDescription: Two Storey Side Extension on the corner side with a First Floor Rear Projection, Single Storey Rear Extension across the full width of the house replacing the Existing Conservatory to form an open plan Kitchen and Dining Room, conversion of the Existing Garage, a remodelled Entrance Hall and Staircase, a wider Lounge, and a new Boundary Fence along the road. My fee is £3,400 plus VAT. As I didn't mention VAT on site, I'm covering half of it, so you pay £3,740.00 in total rather than £4,080.00. See the Goodwill Gesture at the foot of the quotation.

lineItems.description: Goodwill Gesture - Half The VAT Covered
lineItems.itemDescription:
1. On site I quoted my fee as £3,400 and forgot to mention VAT.
2. Full price: £3,400 + VAT at 20% (£680.00) = £4,080.00.
3. As that was my oversight, I am covering half of the VAT, saving you £340.00.
4. This line takes £283.33 off my fee. VAT at 20% on the reduced fee is £623.33, so you pay £3,740.00 in total.
5. Every invoice will show VAT at the full 20%.

1. To the same standard as the statement I showed you on the day. That one was £400; yours is about 70% of the work, as the house isn't in the Green Belt.
2. Not mandatory for a householder application, but it is where the case is made for the side extension and for protecting your neighbour's light and privacy.
3. Strongly advised for this scheme.

1. I act as your agent through to the decision, handling every call and email with the council for you.
2. I always offer it, but on this job I don't think it's good value for you, and I wouldn't take it if I were you.

quotations.additionalTerms: The fee is based on the floor areas and scope agreed on site on 05-Oct-2026: about 25 m² of new ground floor and 30 m² of new first floor. If, before design work starts, the floor area or the complexity of the scheme is reduced, the fee will be adjusted fairly. Changes made after a design option has been drawn do not reduce the fee.
